title: {session}.json (session manifest)
description: Created by step 2 (create-session.sh). cc_session_id is the Claude Code session id captured at step 2 (entry-flow). pid is the OS process id of the live claude main process (resolved by find-claude-pid.sh - walks up the process tree until comm basename == claude). worktree_path / branch / base_branch are populated only when APEX_WORKTREE=1 was set at step 2 (Phase 2 opt-in worktree mode); pre-migration manifests omit them and validate identically. bump_hint is populated by step 12 (worktree-mode only) and consumed by /apex-merge step 6 for the batched VERSION bump. See apex-core.md Conventions / Session manifest schema.

pid.description: OS pid of the live claude main process owning the session. Resolved at create-session.sh time via find-claude-pid.sh. NEVER set to a transient subshell pid - that would mark the session stale to sibling /apex.

cc_session_id.description: Claude Code session id captured at step 2; never overwritten

worktree_path.description: Absolute path to this session's git worktree under <repo>/.apex-worktrees/<session>/. Present iff APEX_WORKTREE=1 at step 2. cleanup-session.sh forks the worktree-aware branch when this key is present; /apex-merge enumerates worktrees via this path.

branch.description: apex/<session> branch name created at step 2 in worktree mode. Same lifecycle as worktree_path: present iff APEX_WORKTREE=1.

base_branch.description: The branch HEAD was on when step 2 created the worktree. /apex-merge step 4 merges apex/<session> back onto this branch (default fall-back: main). Present iff APEX_WORKTREE=1.

bump_hint.description: VERSION bump tier classified by step 12 (worktree mode). /apex-merge step 6 reads every merged session's hint, picks the highest tier across the batch, and runs bump-version.sh ONCE on the final integration commit. Absent in pre-migration sessions (step 12 still bumps directly). minor > patch; major is user-set only.

effective_baseline_sha.description: Optional. Written ONLY when step 8 detects a mid-run baseline supersede (a sibling /apex committed during this run). When present, every downstream step (9-12 + every subagent spawn) reads this in place of baseline.head_sha. Absent = baseline never superseded.
